Agnostic Recommendation Engine
nodes.rationale: The engine should be independent from a specific domain while being validated with movies and TV series, prioritizing modularity, extensibility, and clean separation from infrastructure.

nodes.label: Layered Monolithic Architecture
nodes.rationale: A monolith is selected because the academic project has limited scale and team size; clean/hexagonal principles are used to keep the recommendation core modular.

nodes.label: Recommendation Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Pipeline architecture was selected over weighted ensemble and cascade because it has clear separation of concerns, fits Spring dependency injection, tolerates partial strategy failures, and can evolve toward weighted ensembles.

nodes.label: DataProvider Architecture
nodes.rationale: Strategies remain agnostic by never accessing repositories directly; they request raw or computed data through RecommendationContext and provider caching.

nodes.label: Service Composition Pattern
nodes.author: OpenCode AI Assistant
nodes.rationale: RecommendationService composes entity services rather than repositories directly, keeping orchestration thin and transaction boundaries centralized.

nodes.label: TMDB API Integration
nodes.rationale: TMDB integration uses layered boundaries so HTTP communication, DTOs, mapping, repositories, and orchestration can evolve independently.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Model Strategy
nodes.author: OpenCode AI Assistant
nodes.rationale: Separating JPA entities, domain models, and API DTOs prevents persistence concerns from leaking into business logic or HTTP contracts.

nodes.label: TMDB Service Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Refactoring addresses slow sequential API calls, duplicate movie/TV persistence logic, and missing actor-character metadata.

nodes.label: Mapper Cleanup
nodes.author: TV Looker Team
nodes.rationale: Persistence services should stop doing mapper work; EntityCacheService should resolve entities, mappers should only convert DTOs, and TmdbItemBuilder should construct item graphs.

nodes.label: Persist Methods Refactoring
nodes.author: TV Looker Team
nodes.rationale: Moving persistence methods into TmdbItemPersistenceService applies SRP and DRY by removing duplicated persistence logic from collector and synchronizer services.

nodes.label: TmdbClient Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Use generics, shared media interfaces, and media type enum to eliminate duplicated movie and TV API methods while applying SOLID principles.

nodes.label: TMDB Services Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Centralize external API access through TmdbDataFetcher so rate limiting and asynchronous fetch behavior are handled in one service boundary.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication Design
nodes.rationale: Introduce Spring-native stateless authentication while keeping guest catalog reads public and enforcing ownership through authenticated principals.

nodes.label: Frontend Admin Catalog Profile Design
nodes.rationale: Deliver a focused frontend feature pass plus a narrow backend self-profile endpoint without expanding into broad admin user management or backend filtering specifications.

TmdbCollectionInProgressException
nodes.author: TV Looker Team
nodes.rationale: Ensures that only one TMDB collection operation runs at a time to prevent conflicts.

nodes.label: Recommendation Engine Boundary
nodes.rationale: Recommendation logic stays in domain code, uses RecommendationContext for shared computed data, keeps strategies away from repositories, and wires strategies and aggregators through RecommendationConfig.

nodes.label: HybridRecommendationEngine
nodes.rationale: Combines multiple recommendation strategies, registers shared data providers into context, aggregates results, and post-processes by deduplicating items and dropping invalid scores.

nodes.label: TMDB Persistence Boundary
nodes.rationale: This package is infrastructure rather than domain logic. TMDB DTOs should stay close to external API shape, URL construction should remain inside the client layer, and newer generic client paths are preferred over deprecated endpoint-specific methods.

nodes.label: TmdbClient
nodes.rationale: TmdbClient centralizes HTTP communication with TMDB so callers do not build URLs directly. Rate limiting is intentionally delegated to upstream collection and synchronization services.
